note: Defaults for the hole design simulator. PLACEHOLDER values are unvalidated proof-of-concept defaults. Edits made in Studio are saved per user in AppData, never here.

rows.label: Power Drive: driver carry, mean
rows.note: Proof-of-concept default, not measured shot data.

rows.label: Aim is measured from
rows.note: Your choice on 4 Nov 2026: yards right (+) or left (−) of the line from the tee to the game's aim marker.

rows.label: Native and heavy rough: friction, hop, speed kept
Green: hop, speed kept
rows.note: Rolling friction on the green comes from the Stimp reading (Greens).

rows.label: Bunker, scrub and water
rows.value: The ball stops where it lands

rows.label: Slope and elevation
rows.value: Used only when the terrain gate allows it; otherwise flat ground
rows.note: The ball rolls downhill under gravity and stops when slow on ground flatter than its friction (the proof of concept's rule).

rows.label: Carry change for height
rows.note: 1 yd of carry per 3 ft the landing sits below the tee (less carry when above). Used only with terrain on.

rows.label: Smoothed terrain candidate
rows.note: The proof of concept's smoothing; the terrain study compares it with the plain replay.

rows.label: How the green rolls
rows.value: Friction from the Stimp reading: a ball released at 1.83 m/s rolls the Stimp distance
rows.note: The Stimp reading is the course setting greenSpeed on your two-point line; how the game's greens roll isn't known.

rows.label: Hole drops a ball slower than
Putts struck to finish past the hole by
A stopped ball stays put up to
rows.note: Steeper than this, a ball won't settle: those parts of the green can't hold a pin or a shot.

rows.label: The putter's aim and pace errors
rows.value: Fitted so a flat green matches the baseline's green rows
rows.note: The anchors give 1.04 putts at 3 ft and 1.61 at 10 ft; the contours then decide the rest.

rows.label: The golfer's shot spreads, lie penalties and reach
rows.value: Fitted so a plain calibration hole matches the baseline's rows off the green
rows.note: Flat ground, a 34-yd fairway, rough either side, a round 26-yd green with the pin in the middle. The golfer plays out from each anchor's lie and distance until it holes out.

rows.label: Side spread against distance spread
rows.note: The anchors can't tell side from distance error apart, so the fit keeps this ratio.

rows.label: Native and heavy rough: spread
rows.note: No anchor covers it, so it isn't fitted.

rows.label: Planned release: share of the shot, least, most
rows.note: The golfer carries the ball short of the aim by this much and lets it roll. Your playtest carry and total readings will set it.

rows.label: Chips release
rows.note: A 20-yd chip plans to roll a quarter of its length.

rows.label: Plays-like change for height
rows.note: A green 6 ft above the ball plays 2 yds longer.

rows.label: Tour drive for the tee anchors: carry spread, side spread
rows.note: Only used to fit the tee rows; the carry itself is fitted. Your Power Drive and Normal players set real drives.

rows.label: Best aim
rows.value: The best of 25 aims on a 3-yd grid round the pin, same shots for each

rows.label: Strokes-gained baseline
rows.note: PGA Tour anchors quoted by secondary sources. Sparse: between anchors is linear, outside them is flagged. Replace with the full table from Every Shot Counts.

rows.label: Scrub scores as
rows.note: Recovery: a normal shot at the green isn't possible.

rows.label: Water: penalty strokes, then plays from rough
Painted surface brushes
rows.value: Count where strength ≥ 0.5, as circles of the brush size

rows.label: Bushes, trees and rocks
rows.value: The yardage book's fused masses, played as scrub

rows.label: Cart paths and roads
rows.value: Ignored: the ball plays the ground beneath
